interface.title: Project Field Mouse (Dev Station dashboard)
interface.field: Bioacoustics / ornithology: passive acoustic monitoring with BirdNET
interface.stage_of_work: Reviewing and checking the quality of automated detections after recording
interface.what_it_is_for: A read-only web dashboard for a single recording station that shows BirdNET bird detections as a daily overview, a feed you can filter by confidence, per-species field-note pages with clips, an automatic life list, and device health.

data.note: A synthetic SQLite database from the repo's `simulate --mode errors` command (per the install log): 60 detections and 60 one-second WAV recordings, 4 species (Steller's Jay, Black-capped Chickadee, Song Sparrow, American Robin), all recorded on the evening of Oct 29 local time (Oct 30 UTC). In this mode every third recording (about 20 of 60) is stored as failed (app/simulator.py:97). None of the visited pages show processing status, so the failed recordings never appeared on screen. Every detection shows 'BirdNET only' verification, with no Verification V2 evidence. systemd services are unavailable in this environment, so the service health cards show errors.

features.name: Threshold-filtered event feed with incremental loading
features.general: Filter a time-ordered list of automated detections by a minimum score, see how many match, and page through them
features.specific: On the Activity page, choose All / 60%+ / 80%+ / 90%+, read 'Showing 1–20 of N observations', then press Load more observations and keep scrolling until the end of the listening log
steps: Pick a confidence threshold pill
Read the matching count
Scan newest-first cards with colour-coded BirdNET score bars
Press Load more, then scroll to load the rest
serves_tasks: Narrow the detection list by a minimum confidence
Page through the rest of the log

features.name: Detection review card (score, clip, evidence disclosure)
features.general: One card per automated detection that brings together the label, a colour-banded confidence score, the playable source recording and an expandable verification-evidence panel, so a reviewer can judge the detection in place
features.specific: An observation card with a species link, Recorded/Clip metadata, an inline audio player (visible only at narrow widths), a BirdNET % bar (gold ≥90, green mid, salmon low) and a 'Verification details' disclosure with a status badge ('BirdNET only')
steps: Spot a low-confidence (salmon) score
Play the attached clip, optionally at slower speed
Expand Verification details and read the evidence status
Follow the species link for context
serves_tasks: Open the verification evidence for a detection
Listen to the recording behind a detection to confirm it by ear

features.name: Sortable species collection (life list)
features.general: A cumulative grid of the distinct categories detected so far, each with summary stats, that can be re-sorted by recency, name, count or best score
features.specific: Collected species cards (No., best match %, detections, season, first/last seen, and a badge such as Clear call or Recent discovery) with Recent / Name / Most heard / Confidence sort pills, plus first-discovery, newest-addition and most-frequent summary tiles
steps: Open the Life List
Pick a sort order
Compare the best-match % and detection counts
Click a species to open its record
serves_tasks: Sort the cumulative species list by different criteria
See a species' detection count, confidence and daily history

features.name: Per-category profile with score histogram and filtered clip gallery
features.general: A profile page for one category that summarises its counts, typical time of day, a daily history bar chart and a binned score histogram, with a gallery of its examples that you can filter by score
features.specific: The species page: Total detections / Active days / Average confidence / Best match tiles, Observation Rhythm (typical hour), 14-day Detection History bars with hover counts, Confidence Distribution bins (60–69, 70–79, 80–89, 90–100%), and Recent Clips with All/60/80/90%+ filters and jump links
steps: Open a species from the feed, Home or the Life List
Read the summary tiles and typical hour
Hover a Detection History bar
Read the Confidence Distribution
Filter Recent Clips to 90%+ and jump to Clips
serves_tasks: See a species' detection count, confidence and daily history
Filter one species' clips by confidence

features.name: Hourly activity histogram with hover counts
features.general: A 24-bar chart of event counts by hour of the day, with exact counts shown on hover
features.specific: The Activity Timeline on Home, labelled 'Station-local time' although its hours look like UTC (1–6 AM) next to local card times of 6:33–11:28 PM. The hover tooltip reads like '2 AM: 12 detections' (seen by the replay; no kept screen shows it)
steps: Scroll to the Activity Timeline
Hover an hour bar to read its detection count
Compare the busiest hours with the detection times on the cards
serves_tasks: See which species were detected in the last day, which are new, and when they were heard

features.name: Read-only station health panel
features.general: A status board for a field instrument showing service states, disk and memory use, archive and database size, data freshness and a collapsible technical-details section
features.specific: The Device page: Station Services cards (recorder, BirdNET, dashboard, cleanup timer) with startup and health states, Storage, Memory/load, Database, Recording Health ('Recorder needs attention'), BirdNET Model and Storage Cleanup cards, and 'Show additional technical details'
steps: Open Device
Check the service health and the Recording Health warning
Check disk use and stored recordings
Expand the additional technical details
serves_tasks: Review recorder, detector, storage and database status

Scan Latest Visitors for the species heard most recently

Failed-recording status: the database came from `simulate --mode errors`, so about 20 recordings are stored as failed. No visited page (Home, Activity, species, Life List, Device) shows processing status, so they never appeared
Per-detection audio players at desktop width (1280 or 1600 px): the <audio> element is in each card but not visible. It only appears at narrow widths (420 px)
A species page for a species not in the database returns a plain Flask 404 (screens/045.webp)
The Field notes section of the species page (it has its own jump link but was not opened)
not_done: Could not judge trust from consensus verification evidence: none exists in this data, only the BirdNET score
No control to accept or reject a detection, or to add a species to the life list by hand. The life list is built automatically from all detections.

Could not reliably say when species were heard: the hourly Activity Timeline (labelled 'Station-local time'), the weekly rhythm (all 60 under Fri Oct 30) and the species pages' Detection History and typical hour all group detections in what looks like UTC (1–6 AM, Oct 30), while the cards, Latest Visitors, Recent Discoveries and Life List show local times (6:33–11:28 PM, Oct 29)

No confidence-trend line chart on the species page, only summary tiles, a confidence histogram and a 14-day count bar chart. Detection History showed just one bar (Oct 30, the UTC date of the simulated data) instead of 14 day slots.
Could not download a clip: the audio player's Download menu item did not produce a download (browser_downloads was empty)
Did not hear the audio itself (headless browser). Playback was confirmed by the timer and pause state (0:00/0:01).
The two tooltip readings ('2 AM: 12 detections', '14 detections') come from the replay. The cited screenshots were taken before each hover and show no tooltip.
